info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Investment Portfolio Allocations-v5-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Allocations API provides access to detailed information on investment allocations across various portfolios. Users can retrieve a list of current allocations, enabling effective portfolio management and decision-making. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts, portfolio managers, and investment firms seeking to monitor and analyze their asset distributions. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can ensure that their investment strategies align with market trends and performance metrics.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access a comprehensive list of all allocations within their portfolio, providing insights into asset distribution and resource management.

requestBody.description: Retrieve the allocation details of the portfolio. This request body must specify the criteria to filter the portfolio allocations.

200.description: The request was successful and the data has been retrieved.
